review_description: These guys are great, if you are looking for an installer that is professional and know what they are doing, I can highly recommend Advanced Energy Management.  They installed a Skybox off grid system with 24kw (54 panels) of solar.  The design, installation and commissioning was completed by a very skilled and capable team who kept me informed through the process and remotely monitored the system to ensure it was healthy. A number of the team live with off grid systems so their advice comes from personal experience and an enthusiasm for off grid solar.

The company representative was very knowledgeable and listened to my requirements and was happy to explain the technical details of the equipment that they proposed to use. They provided a very detailed quote within a couple of days of the initial contact. The customer service team were very good in providing suitable dates and all of the paperwork required to get the install booked in. The two installation teams (HPHWS and solar + battery) were very professional and were able to provide workarounds when a couple of minor issues arose. The solar inspector was booked in for the second day of the solar + battery install and there were only a couple of minor issues that the inspector raised and these were addressed on the spot. The Fronius app is very good and provides good information on the performance of the system and state of charge of the battery.

The sales process was really well managed and extremely efficient.I was most impressed with the installation team as they were on time and extremely polite. There were a few bits of rubbish left on the roof from my old installation that they missed during the clean up and there was a slight bit of damage to our ceiling (which was an accident and is being addressed by AEM).The installation is very neat, so a BIG tick for that one.The after sales was a little strange as the processes must have changed as to how the power company do their testing.I got a call a couple of days after the installation had been completed to ask that the battery be switched off while they (Powercor) do the tests however within 48 hours I was advised that the testing was complete and I was fully operational.So overall I would have to say that I am very happy that I made the choice to go with AEM and I would (and have) recommend(ed) them to others.

I purchased a 6.6 Solar system with 5kw inverter 3.5 years ago off Advanced Energy and couldn’t be happier, and recently purchased 4.4kw of solar panels and 24kw battery, the quote was very competitive and Matt the sales/project manager was brilliant in every aspect. The installers were also top notch with their workmanship and commissioning of the system I would recommend them to anyone looking for solar.

I am very happy with the quality of the 8.8kW system that has been installed and EV charger.The sales person was extremely helpful and enthusiastic, and keen to help with my installation. I have now had the system installed for one month and I believe the system has been performing at least as well as the sales person had said it would which is reassuring. He came out and did a site inspection and flew a drone over the house to identify how many panels could be installed. My one gripe was that the installer contradicted the sales persons assessement of the scope of work and the number of panels that could fit on the roof, and I ended up with one less panel and a slightly higher bill.The installation was done in a professional manner and was within the time they had said. This was an installation on a 2nd storey which I did not consider to be easy to do however I was impressed with how the installers handled the installation.The panels have performed exactly as promised by AEM (actually probably slightly better) so I am very happy with this. I am seeing very solid energy savings as a result of these panels, converting the house to run on electricity and using an EV. I believe the payback on the system will be quicker than AEM had indicated due to moving from gas to electricity AND installing panels, as well as the EV.Well done AEM!

Mathew was my first contact for Advanced Energy Management. He was friendly, good to talk to, patient and knowledgeable.Installation was carried out by one of their subcontractors. They were punctual, friendly and completed the install quickly and professionally.I was being one of those customers who were stressed and worried about the functionality and performance after the install, however they were really good in keeping me updated and informed of any issues.Would recommend Advanced Energy Management.

AEM were fantastic from the very start to finish with the installation.I received communication quickly to aid in the quote process and then a phone call follow up a day later. From quote request to receiving a quote was quick, the company were very responsive.I liked that they delved more deeply into my electricity usage data over the last year, rather than just relying on one bill and estimations of usage. They took the time to explain, and left me feeling confident in their product and quote.The installation was smooth and the workmen were punctual, friendly and efficient, finishing up within half a day.AEM team showed me how to use the system, and organised all the back end after install. They were always very clear in their communication and what they needed from me.I will highly recommend this company to others for their professionalism, work ethic, and no nonsense approach. They supply a great product within your budget and outline options for you.I will happily be a returning customer if I need additional panels or upgrades in future.

I have no hesitation in highly recommending Advanced Energy Management. We had a new system installed over the last 2 days that included removing our old panels and inverter and replacing with new panels, inverter and a battery. From start to finish the process was without fault and we could not be happier. From the initial thorough and informative consultation with James, to his equally thorough and informative site visit, we were very impressed with his knowledge, professionalism, and the time he took to explain everything. Nothing was too much trouble, could not have asked for more.Aaron, our CEC accredited installer and his team were also excellent, and they did a fantastic job. They were punctual, friendly, hard working, and thoroughly cleaned up packaging and debris before leaving. Aaron went through the new system with me and has arranged the Inspection on our behalf, hopefully to be done in the next couple of days. So very happy I chose them to install our new system. Deserves more than 5 stars.

Great sales person, very informative and easy to get in contact with. Fast installation with great communication beforehand. All people from the company were professional. So excited to see the power we are generating and how easy it was, wish we'd installed it earlier.

The sales person (Matt) was exceptionally good at answering all my questions and educating me about Solar for my homeThe Customer Service team went above and beyond in assisting me with the govt rebates and connecting me to the grid.Again, explaining everything to an exceptional level.The installation team were absolutely awsome and they were polite, quick, helpful and again assisted me when I had questions. The installation team even showed me how to use the portal. It has been an extremely smooth process.

Had a great experience with Marcus from Advanced Energy Management. His communication was exceptional and ensured I got the perfect system for my home. A comprehensive shading analysis was performed with a detailed rundown what it all meant for the setup of my system.Marcus was very quick to get back to any questions I had no matter what time of day.The installers did a truly amazing job and were out in a day. (And not one tile broken!)I would highly recommend Advanced Energy Management to anyone looking for a great solar experience throughout the entire process.

Top shelf experience at Advanced Energy Management.The initial consultations with James was a great experience, he took the time to understand my needs and was able to propose a system that would accommodate my future requirements.From that moment, I already had the trust in this company and the service, response and aftercare support from Cheryl, Charlene and Matt has been phenomenal.The people behind this business are just great people who want to help and do the right thing which is hard to find.Very happy with the service and system installed, would highly recommend.

I used SolarQuotes to obtain my 3 quotes & chose AEM from those in February 2024.  James quoted the job which is an unusual one thanks to my curved roofline. Sadly, events transpired that required me to pause installation until later in the year.  I contacted James with that news and he was most helpful considering it meant pausing the job indefinitely.I contacted James in October, he attended to ensure the install was still viable.  He changed some components with newer ones that were released since my original quote  and we recommenced the application.   The heat pump HWS install was done one month later and the Solar PV, and batteries were completed early December.All the work is great quality and I can't thank Aaron and his install team enough.  There was a minor connection issue that required he come back after the weekend, they were there first thing Monday morning to remedy the problem.   Their attitude and skill with an unusual install was exemplary.   I had to ring Mathew days before Christmas with a question and he returned the call with an answer before going on a well earned Christmas break.   Very happy with the install and the customer service.

The process of obtaining quotes was not without difficulties in getting accurate and reliable information. Matt and James from AEM provided great advice and the system they provided is proving itself in our rural setting with a very flaky grid supply. Water pumps are operating well with no interruptions when the grid fails. David from Illuma Electrical Group did the installation on the day and his team's workmanship was praised by the electrical inspector. The only downside was the tardy response from the AEM office in providing paperwork after the completion of the installation.

ADVANCED ENERGY MANAGEMENT is very well named, I told them what I was looking for and they gave me a quote for exactly that. The installation team were awesome and gave me pictures of the installation. The install was done a lot sooner than I expected as it was a large number of solar panels but no problems the team were very polite.Eight months later I decided that I needed a battery to make the most of the solar power being created, I got 3 quotes but because of my previous experience with ADVANCED ENERGY MANAGEMENT were hoping they would come through- again their quote gave me a battery which will meet my needs,,,,,WOW the installation so impressive again the staff so polite , friendly, tidy and quick. Half way through the installation I suggested a change, 2.5kw of 10 year solar panels on the house when we purchased it. I asked if they could be moved to the inverter of the battery as 10 year old inverter  maybe getting a bit tired. No problem but it added a bit of time to the installation. Overall I feel these people really know what they are doing and do a quality job

The whole process was fine it took a little bit longer than expected and and sometimes the communication between installers and Head Office was a bit off but overall everybody was very helpful and polite and we’d happily use them again
Advanced energy management are a fantastic company, a great team of staff from the quoting to installation. Highly recommend.
Very easy to deal with and installation and connection to grid all organised very efficient. Very happy

I needed to add a few panels to my existing solar system, but since I already had the panels, it was a very small job. Most solar installers weren’t interested, but Advanced Energy Management was fantastic from the start. I spoke with James, who assured me they’d be happy to take on the project. We quickly agreed on a fair price and a date for the installation. On the scheduled day, the team arrived right on time and got straight to work. Within a few hours, the panels were installed and working perfectly. I couldn’t be happier with their professionalism and service, and I highly recommend Advanced Energy Management.

I was working with another supplier, when AEM suggested a superior configuration of 16 Aiko 470W panels in landscape which made best use of my limited roof space. This made possible a 7.5kW system with a 6kW inverter. AEM were very well organised and efficient. On the day, the lift arrived first, then safety fence installers, then two electricians and a team of panel installers. The system was running by 4pm, and officially inspected. I received emails registering the inverter with Fronius, STC registration and the final invoice. The fences and crane left next morning. Very satisfied.

Our AEM experience was run like a military precision project!!From the time we engaged AEM for an onsite inspection to the final electrical inspection was like clock work.The sales rep was knowledgeable & had all the answers to our queries.All parts of the install process were seamless, the team turned up on time, kept us informed of what needed to happen when, eg turning power on /off. When the team finish the job our yard was left clean & tidy. No rubbish including the disposal of old solar panels.The AEM team are excited about their products as we were.

Jason quoted my install. He was extremely knowledgeable and was able to answer all my questions. Three companies quoted the job and Jason was the only company representative to come to site.The install team were punctual, experienced and tidy. All questions were answered. Great team.Everything was well organised and well run. I am quite impressed with this company.Thanks Jason, Herman, Matt and Charlene.

I recently had Advance Energy Management install solar panels at my home, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the entire process! From the initial consultation to the final installation, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and extremely helpful.I found Advance Energy Management through the Solar Quotes website, and I’m so glad I did. James from sales deserves a special shout-out. He was incredibly informative and patient, happily answering my many questions about solar technology. James also came to my property for an on-site visit, which made a huge difference in understanding my needs and tailoring the solution accordingly. He recommended Aiko solar panels as the best bang for my buck, and I couldn’t be happier with the choice. After doing my own research, I found that the Goodwe inverter and Aiko solar panels that AEM suggested had positive reviews and were highly recommended. Additionally, James offered to do a post-installation inspection of my system, ensuring everything was working perfectly.The installers arrived on time, and the installation was completed on schedule. The electricians were respectful, tidy, and efficient. The quality of the work and the attention to detail were outstanding. Plus, I only had to wait four days for the Licensed Electrical Inspector to come to my property, fully inspect the solar installation, and get approval to have the system turned on.I’m particularly impressed with their customer service—they kept me informed at every step and ensured everything was running smoothly. I highly recommend Advance Energy Management for anyone considering solar panel installation. Their commitment to excellence is evident in every aspect of their service.
The whole process, from start to finish, was really excellent

Matt and the team have done a great job in installing 12.2Kw solar. Matt was patient with the million questions i had and the install took place over 2 days. He accommodated all the last minute changes and post install cleanup was great by the team. I would not hesitate in recommend AEM to anyone, great people, honest and care about their quality of work.  The system is producing more than anticipated so i am really impressed.
So far, all good, highly recommended Company, for their straight forward explanations, and help with the rebate process with Solar Victoria

AEM Seemed the most technically knowledgeable of the installers about my unique situation.I had an interesting connection where I had 2 x 2 phase meters to the property (as the previous owner of the property ran a business out of the shed) AEM seemed to be the only installer who was willing to abolish one meter as part of the install, and made the whole process go seamlesslyThey came to my house to do an inspection and understand my requirements prior to providing a quote.Quoted on the specific equipment I wanted, and mounted it it where I asked.Install team were polite, thorough and left the jobsite clean and tidy.

Sales quoting process was outstandingCustomer service was outstandingInstallation was polite punctual & they worked really well as a crew.But just failed on clean up.Off cuts of wires were left in the gutters.Had to get up on the roof to clean the gutters as the wires would have went into my water tank.

I installed a new solar and battery system to replace my small solar that had stopped working.  AEM took the time to listen and advise, where others told me what i needed and didn’t listen.  The sales process went like a charm, however the installation was harder that expected. Andrew (installer) was brilliant, he involved us in solution options and did a great job.

The installers for Advanced Energy Management did an excellent job with the installation of our solar power system. They were punctual and worked efficiently to complete the job on time. They were a polite team of workers keen to do a good job. The team leader kept me informed of progress and explained the ap and how the system worked on completion and what to expect in terms of connection to the grid.

AEM, among the companies suggested by Solar Quotes, stood out. After receiving three quotes from different companies, AEM's pricing fell in the middle range. Ultimately, the choice of AEM was influenced by my partner, a professional graphic designer, who found AEM's website to be the most polished, exhibiting attention to detail.During the phone consultation, AEM proved to be the most thorough, investing the most time in addressing our queries. Their commitment to follow-ups surpassed that of the other two companies, who only sent a single email after one or two weeks.Scheduling the appointment with AEM was swift, and the installation was completed in less than five hours. The removal of handrails followed promptly a couple of days later. Despite heavy rains, the work held up well, no leaks.A month after the installation, AEM reminded me via email to ensure that the feed-in tariff had been registered with my energy retailer, emphasizing their commitment to after-sales support.Based on my experience, I would gladly recommend AEM to my friends.

Two of my guiding principles in life are:Set the right expectationsWhen you pay peanuts you get monkeysAdvanced Energy Management set the right expectations in every way by discussing the advantages and disadvantages of the system they proposed and planning for the best results in everyday use and in blackout situations.  They answered all my questions as to why they configured the proposed system the way they did.It wasn't the cheapest but for us it was the best for our situation.I was very impressed with their install team (Danny, Jimmy and Ross) and have no hesitation in recommending AEM
All round great experience. From the consultations, quotes to installation, communication was always easy, but comprehensive. Actual installation was very smooth and professionally handled.

AEM did a great job from start to finish. I personally spoke to the sales, installation and management team, if ever there was a query, question or request.The Installers lead by Chandler smashed it out of the park.He was super organised and had the inspector there on the day.We have a working system running now...YAY!

AEM were fantastic through the whole process, right from initial conversation with James to the amazing install team lead by Andrew on the day.James took the time to talk in detail around the system options, best design for my current & future needs and followed up with a site visit to nail the design in.The install and the job the guys did is top notch and aesthetically pleasing to look at even though it sits in a garage. Even ensure any broken tiles were look after is a testament to the workmanships. The bonus was the clean removal of our existing system & helping us with best disposal options.Wasn’t the cheapest we could get but the quality we obtained made the marginal difference completely worth it!

An excellent experience all round.-  detailed investigation of requirements including a site inspection and analysis of electricity usage history.- detailed quote covering all components including provision of technical specifications for panels/inverter.-  clear explanation of process for making claim for solar rebate.-  emailed description of what to expect when installation commenced.-  installation occurred over 2 days as anticipated.  All details were well co-ordinated.   Scaffolder, installers, electrical inspection followed the planned sequence and were all completed in the 2 days.-  Site workers were courteous, friendly, and happy to answer any questions.Overall - thoroughly satisfied.

It was the first Installer that you quoted me which was Smartlyte NOT Advance Energy Management.The reason for selecting Smartlyte was, that he had the most reasonable quote & did not use subcontractors & he was able to install in quick time within a few days of accepting his quote and he was able to put all 23 Solar Panels on my Northernly facing roof were some of the other Installers said it could not be done!!!!! I did not accept any quotes for placing any solar panels on my 19.5 X 4.5 meter Flat Stratco Roof as it might collapse under the weight. Mr. Jacob Navosa did an excellent job around having put in the solar panels, inverter & batteries as well as changing 23 LED lights & installing a extra split system of which we have 5 split systems in our house. Just waiting for an inspector to inspect the whole system.

We contacted Advanced Energy Management because we dealt with them years ago and although at that time we were not ready to upgrade our solar we were given some truthful advice. So when we moved house we thought we would deal with them again. During our sales enquirer I spoke with an actual electrician who could answer all my questions accurately on the spot with no bull. I was really impressed with all the knowledge he had especially of the products they had on offer. Even the specific hardware was described to me in detail. At the end I received two quotes of different sized systems and we went with the one that meet our need best. This choice was made easier due to the easy to follow quotation and a quick follow up call to the same sales person who was so helpful and patient answering my specific questions.Th installation started promptly and the crew were easy to understand and professional. The job was neatly done and exceeded my expectations. The senior installer was supper friendly and even suggested to place the inverter in a place where I  never thought was possible and even though it was harder to do there was no extra cost. Most of the electrical wiring was hidden behind the brick work which made the job look so neat.As the installers were packing up that afternoon the inspector came and gave it the all clear and we were producing solar and enjoying our generation of power.We were so happy with the entire process that I went down in person to their office to thank the team and express how happy we were. I was even invited in the office and shown in detail how the Solar System was performing.

Having got my 3 quotes from Solar Quotes, I spoke to each of the installers recommended and came away very impressed with my conversation with James at Advanced Energy Mgt.James took time to speak to me at length, about everything I wanted to achieve, and the process involved.Because we live in a relatively new, 2 story townhouse, our roof is divided in 4 smallish zones, so that required some fiddling with landscape orientation of the panels.  It also meant that we would need to remove the old solar evac hot water & gas booster.  To further maximise generation, we decided to have an extra 3 panels in portrait on top of the pergola.Having to remove the old hot water system, bought the opportunity to install an iStore heat pump.The week of the install, the roofers arrived to install the safety fence on the roof. 2 story requirment in Vic. Then Simon the plumber arrived first to remove the old hot water system, and install the heat pump.  They had to come back the following day to remove the old roof unit, and while on the roof he fixed a leak that I had asked him about.Andy the solar installer, arrived at 8am on the Weds, to start the install, this took the rest of the week, due in part to heavy rain making working at height unsafe.By Friday evening the system was completed and working and awaiting final sign off from the inspector, which was duly done.The slowest part of the process was getting the system registered and the meter configuration updated by Jemena and Simply.Have been super happy with the system, the quality of the install and its reliability.
Great customer service and a quick and efficient installation process.

I was referred to AEM by a friend who used them. And it has been one of my best recommendations.They guided me through all the Solar Vic process, provided me with viable options, and everything that they promised, happened, and when they said it would happen.The install went smoothly, A very neat install, and the system was signed off & activated the very next day.Now, 2+ years after the install, I am very happy with the system, which is working perfectly and I'm only about 6 months away from breaking even from all my install costs.Just an excellent group of guys who REALLY know their business.

Our salesman James proved to be highly knowledgeable, making a strong impression on me and he really stood out among the other companies we engaged for quotes.  His experience as an former installer was very obvious, and helpful.  He was also the only one willing to come out and measure our roof, which he did promptly.  He was very friendly and patiently answered all of my questions.We have a complex, fairly solar-unfriendly roof.  Of all the quotes we received, AEM designed the largest, taking my request to "fill the roof" seriously, and making use of all 6 faces to make the most of what we had (and yes, we do plan to remove that evap cooling unit to avoid shading the panels!).  We also had some existing solar hotwater panels that we wanted removed and replaced with PV panels.  James was willing to make changes to the plan (including various minor informational things that affected projected production values, such as the tilt of the panels to match our building plans), and amend the quote to add our condition of being subjected to the site inspection not finding and major differences from the plan and we signed and paid our deposit on the 10th of October.We had quite a bit of rain over the next two months which unfortunately delayed installation more than we'd have liked - and the industry has been very busy, so we were getting nervous that our install would even get done in 2022 as we were approaching the end of the year - but the weather was beyond anyone's control.  They arranged the solar HW panels to be removed within a month of paying the deposit, and installation started on the 5th of December.  It took 2.5 days to complete given the complexity.The installation team, Chandler & co, were fantastic.  They were friendly, punctual, and hard working, and cleaned up after themselves.  Things were not smooth (e.g. unfavourable weather to be working on a roof at times, plans couldn't be followed exactly due to the unavailabity of the originally specified panels that were measured for), but Chandler came up with an alternate solution that resulted in no loss to the size, or any change to the cost of the system, and they moved mountains to get the job done in time.  They arranged inspection on the last day and it was completed before they left my premises.  There were some minor issues with monitoring and production on some microinverters that were resolved over the next two weeks, with an additional visit they managed to squeeze in before Christmas.They did help organise grid connection promptly after the install (or after I paid, I'm not sure which, as I paid promptly), and it was just today, roughly a month later that the distributor finally did that.All-in-all I'm very happy with the system so far, and in my dealings with AEM.  They satisfactorily solved all the issues that came along and my partner and I are grateful they got everything done and the system was fully operational before the end of year.  Well done team, keep up the good work!

This was the most expensive quote I received being on the order of 10% more than most others. However, I went with it as the salesperson gave me considerable confidence by spending time both on the phone and in a site visit. They also demonstrated a deeper understanding of all things Solar/Battery related in comparison to others.There was no hard sell, no limited time offers, and they weren't trying to sell me outdated components or bundle in with a particular energy provider.Installers were on time, professional and paid attention to details with all work completed in two days. The inspector only picked up some minor issues which I'm promised will be rectified in the coming weeks. There was some minor plasterwork damage (from a dropped tape measure), but things are in process to get that repaired and repainted.The system has now been running for 3 weeks and I've only needed to pull 300W from the grid overnight once after a run of cloudy days. I'm still not earning FiT but that's through no fault of AEM and down to the clunky systems employed by my power wholesaler and retailer.I know I might have been able to get slightly better value for money elsewhere, but I'm confident it would have come at the cost of install quality and/or after sales support.

Very happy with all parts of the installation process. Never felt I was being up-sold anything unnecessary and the team at Advanced Energy Management were all happy to answer my questions.Installation ran smoothly and was organised in a timely manner. Would recommend them to friends and family.

Wanted to increase output of existing solar system enabling me to make the change to all electric appliancesAsk two solar consulting agencies to recommend three companies each for quotes on solar upgrade to existing systemReceived company details and contacted all sixOne was unable to helpAnother wanted to scrap existing system and install their new systemThree others hounded me to let them install Chinese systems and batteryAEM responded with proposed quote and made contact a few days later to see if i was interested in proceeding with their quote - response YesNotified other customers that their quote was unsuccessful and two wanted to know why, and one wanted me to tell them details of price and system so they could give better price response no sorryJason from AEM (Senior Consultant) came for free site inspection armed with droneGave him copies of electricity bill etc and he provided me with two layout quotesAEM said my current electricity usage for one person in household did not warrant the high expense of installing a solar batteryI accepted option number two and after making a couple of refinements arrangements were made for Deposit amount and proposed installation date proposedWas great that AEM arranged solar rebate and notified all parties involved and kept me updated all the wayPaid deposit and happy with installation date a couple of days laterInstallation done professionally and safely with installation of security hand rails and on completion put security padlock on Inverter to stop system being activatedQualified electrical inspector came a few days later and was happy with the quality of work done but asked AEM to remove one of my older panels from string as nine panels were a slight overload to inverter and to be coupled up withnew bank of five panelsAEM came back immediately with possible solution to replace the old panel with an extra new panel to make string of six compatible at extra reduced price for unforseen problemAEM rang back later that day to say that one of their engineers came up with a cheaper and simpler way of addressing the problem of one panel not being the same output wattage as the new panels on the string which would reduce the output of entire string by attaching a Tigo Optimiser to boost power outage of that panel to conform to others on that stringIngenious solution and a lot cheaper at $200 for Tigo installation and rewiring  the two new string configurations thus  satisfying Safety Electrical Engineers requestSpecial thanks to Jason and AEM teamVery happy with entire process and would highly recommend this company to everyone

All communication with AEM was great. Prompt, informative, helpful, friendly and professional. From the outset, when Jase visited and explained the project details, we felt comfortable that all would go smoothly. Hermanto was fantastic. He organised installation which took only 3 weeks from acceptance of the proposal, and the installation team were a great group of guys - knew what they were doing, and got on with the job. They were very nice guys too. We were really happy with that. The whole team, sales, admin, managerial, installation, work really well together. We have had no problems with anything. It was a very pain free process. Thanks AEM!

James was very informative and helpful through the quoting process. The installers were great, communicated the whole process and were very tidy and respectful.James and the installers were all very helpful, knowledgeable, professional and respectful.

Can't praise my experience with AEM enough. The salesman was extremely helpful and explained everything in a way that was easily understood. Once I accepted the quote the excellent service didn't stop there. Any questions I had were answered happily and thoroughly and the installers were lovely. They were tidy and polite and were happy to wait for the system to generate power to show it was working (which was quite a while). All in all I would recommend this company to anyone looking to install solar panels or hot water.
Easy and informative, professional, on time and efficient. Managed rebates well.

Our salesperson, Jason, was friendly, helped us choose the best system for us and made the process easy to understand.The installation happened on time and the inspector came the same day, so we were up and running with solar power straight away.The installer were friendly, efficient and open to any questions we had.All in all a very good experience with Advanced Energy.

From a first general inquiry, from PV novices, through to discussions on aspects of each potential providers quotes, we found AEM to be direct and factual in their offering and this was backed up by an experienced and knowledgeable team.  Once options were settled on (full system with battery and export) the onsite team made sure the look and functionality of the system was fit for purpose and delivered optimum results. The installation was seemless and very professional. Also, the customer experience was so well managed by clear and regular feedback. AEM are the best I’ve dealt with and I thoroughly recommend them for your consideration.

James was great up front in helping design a system. I appreciated the fact he was more than happy to come and inspect our property to provide confidence that the system would fit as planned (three story property with a split roof added some complication).The install took place over two days and Wishan, Phil and the team were top notch. Super respectful and kept me informed throughout. Would certainly recommend.

These guys are super friendly, approachable, easy to deal with and trustworthy.They attended with a drone for the site inspection and explained why I didn’t need additional panels and boutique-solar options that the competitors were padding quotes with.They were able to assist with a wallbox smart EV charger which has worked out really well in Melbourne’s winter where it will ‘top-up’ Solar charging with grid power when necessary.However installation was more difficult than expected by their sales and it took several days longer across multiple weeks.They absorbed the cost.I would absolutely use them again but I can work from home to accommodate scheduling and miscommunication.

I was contacted by Advanced Energy Management that my solar system was not online.  I was unaware and extremely grateful for the phone call.  Excellent service and communication provided and I was back on line in no time!  I appreciated that I was called within a week and I found the service exceptional.  Highly recommended installation, service and attention to detail.

The solar industry can be a bewildering place to the uninformed (I place myself in this category) full of grifters quivering with anticipation at the thought of government rebates. That is why AEM stands out amount the crowd. From the first time I contacted them I felt they were actually trying to design a system that would work for me, not for their bottom line, and their unwavering support continues to this day, even though the system is up and running perfectly and paid for in full. I feel extremely fortunate to have selected them and highly recommend that you do the same.

Very competitive quote using quality components.Was really happy with the knowledge and the design process.The installation was a complex second story job and I was really happy with the installers and their manner.Really happy with the end result.
